svg.title: Provincial arms — Fire-weather Instruments manual
svg.desc: Uses the user-selected Plateforge 1917-late / Type3 native full achievement, preserving deer, ram, royal crest, BC shield and motto. Source book covers confirm an older full achievement. This supplied reference is an interpretation of the historical printing; an exact match to the cover engraving and print stroke weight is not asserted. Photograph texture and perspective are excluded.
